name: Eleanor Buck Wolf Nature Center Summer Camp
street_address: Eleanor Buck Wolf Nature Center, 156 Prospect Street
description_short: A town nature camp at the Eleanor Buck Wolf Nature Center in Wethersfield, in nine weekly sessions with science and nature themes, 8 am to 4:30 pm. Campers learn about animals and the outdoors, do crafts, games and music, swim at Mill Woods Park pool, and the oldest group, Trailblazers, takes a weekly field trip.
refund_policy_summary: Written requests only. Full refund less a $10 processing fee two weeks before the program; 50% less $10 one week before; no refunds less than one week before.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers in back to back sessions get two weeks of swim lessons at Mill Woods Park pool; others have free swim.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp Parent Handbook 2026: nine sessions June 22 to August 21, no camp July 3. Camp hours 8 am to 4:30 pm, extended hours 4:30 to 5:30. Campers bring a bag lunch and two snacks. Groups by last grade completed or age; staff ratios are given for ages 5 to 12, but the handbook states no age range or fee. The program is not licensed by the state.

source.title: Wethersfield Parks and Recreation Summer Camp Parent Handbook 2026

changes: Used the 2026 season: no 2027 information is posted.
for_andrew: The 2026 handbook gives no grade range or fee. The town's Summer Camp page (https://wethersfieldct.gov/283/Summer-Camp) says Nature Camp is pre-K 4 year olds to grade 4 and Bears Camp grades 5 and 6, but its only date is a 2025 open house and the 2026 handbook names the older group Trailblazers instead. Use those grades, or leave ages out?
